<style>
.login-background {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --background: 240 21% 15%;
  --foreground: 226 64% 88%;
  --card: 240 21% 12%;
  --card-foreground: 226 64% 88%;
  --popover: 240 21% 12%;
  --popover-foreground: 226 64% 88%;
  --muted: 237 16% 23%;
  --muted-foreground: 228 24% 72%;
  --accent: 237 16% 23%;
  --accent-foreground: 226 64% 88%;
  --border: 234 13% 31%;
  --input: 234 13% 31%;
  --ring: 226 64% 88%;
  font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  background: #1e1e2e;
}
.login-background > div:first-of-type,
.login-content,
#footer {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}
.login-background::before {
  content: '';
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%, rgba(245, 194, 231, 0.10) 0, transparent 30%), radial-gradient(circle at 85% 25%, rgba(137, 220, 235, 0.10) 0, transparent 30%), radial-gradient(circle at 75% 85%, rgba(166, 227, 161, 0.08) 0, transparent 30%), radial-gradient(circle at 20% 85%, rgba(250, 179, 135, 0.08) 0, transparent 30%);
}
.login-content > div {
  max-width: 420px;
}
.login-panel {
  border: 1px solid #45475a;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: #181825;
  box-shadow: 0 30px 70px -24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
}
.login-background > div:first-of-type button {
  color: #a6adc8;
}
.signin-methods > div {
  border: 1px solid #45475a;
  background: #11111b;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'] {
  color: #a6adc8;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'][data-state='active'] {
  background: #313244 !important;
  color: {{accentColor}};
  box-shadow: none !important;
}
.login-form label {
  color: #bac2de;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  height: 44px;
  border: 1px solid #45475a;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #11111b;
  color: #cdd6f4;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio'])::placeholder {
  color: #a6adc8;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):focus {
  border-color: {{accentColor}};
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 25%, transparent);
}
.login-password button {
  color: #a6adc8;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'] {
  border-color: #a6adc8;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'][data-state='checked'] {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  border-color: {{accentColor}};
  color: #11111b;
}
.login-form a {
  color: {{accentColor}};
  font-weight: 500;
}
.login-form .login-button {
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: {{accentColor}};
  color: #11111b;
  font-weight: 600;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form .login-button:hover {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  filter: brightness(1.08);
}
.login-form .login-signup-link,
.login-form .login-forget-password label {
  color: #bac2de;
}
#footer {
  color: #a6adc8;
}

.login-panel {
  border-radius: 20px;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']),
.login-form .login-button {
  border-radius: 12px;
}
.login-form .login-forget-password {
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
